mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over a 3-month horizon signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases by > 0.5% in 3 months while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over 6 months signals labor market weakness, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 4.5% for 6 months while S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% for 3 months while S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,200 units over 6 months signals weakening residential construction activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and housing sector earnings.
failure_condition: HOUST rises above 1,200 units while S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 new jobs per month over 3 months signals labor market strength, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: PAYEMS remains below 150,000 while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 108 over 3 months signals manufacturing expansion, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 108 while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 250 over 6 months signals disinflationary pressures, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced inflation uncertainty and lower discount rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL remains above 250 while S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Retail Sales Index (RSAFS) above 500,000 million dollars over 3 months signals consumer spending strength, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: RSAFS remains below 500,000 while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances.
